Hi Samira — great to meet you earlier. I added Karthik (procurement ops) and Vanessa (billing) to the thread. Below is the standard "what we need from you" and what Redwood will take on. I'll attach the vendor form and PO template.

What we need from Onyx (please return within ~48-72 hours):
- Completed Redwood vendor intake form (attached: Onyx_Vendor_Form.xlsx)
- W9 or equivalent tax document (US suppliers) — please attach as PDF
- Bank details or EFT instructions for ACH (bank name, account name, routing)
- Primary AP contact and billing email
- Any required compliance certificates if handling regulated data (if applicable)

What Redwood will provide / do:
- Create vendor record in our system and confirm vendor code (RDW-XXXX)
- Route and approve PO requests once vendor is active
- Provide Redwood PO template and next steps for PO acknowledgement
- Set invoice submission address: invoices@redwood.com

PO routing notes (action for Karthik):
- For initial purchase we typically issue a one-off PO after vendor activation; standard lead time is 2 business days after we receive completed intake + W9.
- For recurring contracts, we'll set up blanket PO or monthly invoicing as agreed.

Attached: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf, Onyx_Vendor_Form.xlsx

Next steps: Samira, please fill the attached form and send the W9. Karthik — once I have confirmation from Samira I'll kick off vendor activation and loop Marissa (legal) if a master agreement redline is needed. Vanessa, FYI for billing config.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick clarifications on PO routing and internal approvals:
- PO issuance: Procurement (me) will create the PO in Coupa. Tessa will create the vendor record; I will then assign a temporary vendor code and advance the PO to AP for final approval.
- Approval thresholds: initial PO <= $25k can route through standard approvers; above that we'll need director-level approval. If Onyx expects a >$25k kickoff, flag it upfront.
- Required fields to avoid delays: legal company name exactly as on W9, tax ID, payment terms, and billing contact email.

Samira — once you return the vendor form + W9 I can typically get the PO in draft the same day and approved within 24–48 hours depending on approvals.
